Perhaps the performance which gave us most pleasure was that of our team (Bird, Botwright, Jarlett, Pack) in taking second place to Achilles A.C. in the A.A.A. 4 x 440 yards Relay Championship.
Syd Jarlett kept us well there and then Stan Blundell went off over the first half lap, and Stan Botwright took over for the final run home.
In the Middlesex County Championships four sprinters—Botwright, Wiley, Pritchard and yours truly, Bennett—entered and all gained County Standards.

The first race was the 100 yds., Bowers running very well to be beaten by inches, Ransome, T.C.C., winning in 10-9, Botwright 3rd. Ransome also scored in the 220 yds., Botwright finishing 2nd and Bowers 4th.

Jack Frost beat Reynolds of the Police in the 100 Yards with Stan Botwright third. The latter, however, won the 220 with Ted Read in second place.
The 100 Yards Club Championship was won by Ted Read, who beat Dicky Dumbrill with Jack Frost third, and the holder, Stan Botwright, beaten into fourth place.
